label: Traditional dress
description: Named traditional garments and ensembles worn today, grouped by cultural area with regional tags.
notes: Named traditional garments and ensembles worn today belong here, including everyday, formal, festival, and dance dress. clothing.fashion_style owns fashion aesthetics and revival styling; clothing.fabric owns cloth types apart from named garments. Values are noun phrases after “wearing,” with familiar garment names and brief ensemble qualifiers where needed to distinguish their silhouettes. Region describes the garment tradition rather than the wearer’s descent; broad browse areas can span several regions, and presentation tags appear only on clearly gendered forms. Tiers balance familiar starting points with more specific dress forms, rather than ranking cultures.
